text.tspan: A legacy of purity from wildflower fields to your
table. NatureGold partners directly with independent,
sustainable beekeepers. We never micro-filter or
flash-heat our honey, keeping all natural enzymes,
antioxidants, and rich floral flavors perfectly intact—just
* Instructions: Delicious in tea, drizzled over toast, or used
as a natural sweetener in your favorite baking recipes.
* Storage Note: Store at room temperature. If honey
crystallizes, gently place the jar in warm water to liquefy.
Do not feed honey to infants under one year of age.
